items.name: Interhyp
items.partnerbankenText: More than 500 lenders (savings banks, cooperative banks, private and direct banks, insurers)
items.standorteText: Over 140 locations across Germany, around 1,400 employees
items.beratungText: Free and non-binding — Interhyp earns a commission from the lending bank if a financing deal closes
items.besonderheitenText: Describes itself as Germany's largest broker of private mortgages; carries Finanztip's recommendation seal (valid through end of 2026)
items.sourcesNote: Figures per interhyp.de (the provider's own claims, not independently verified), as of October 2026

items.name: Dr. Klein
items.partnerbankenText: Number of partner banks not stated on the provider's website
items.standorteText: Around 240–250 locations, 600–700 advisors (figures vary slightly across the provider's own pages)
items.beratungText: Free and non-binding — Dr. Klein earns a commission from the lending bank if a financing deal closes
items.besonderheitenText: A 100% subsidiary of Hypoport SE (Lübeck); per the provider, ranked 1st in the customer-advice category in a comparison of 15 mortgage brokers (06/2026)
items.sourcesNote: Figures per drklein.de (the provider's own claims, not independently verified), as of October 2026

items.name: Baufi24
items.partnerbankenText: More than 600 banks, insurers and building societies
items.beratungText: Free and non-binding — Baufi24 earns a commission from the lending bank if a financing deal closes
items.besonderheitenText: Named "best mortgage broker 2026" by business magazine €uro and analysis institute SWI in July 2026 (26 providers tested); part of the Bilthouse group (alongside Hüttig & Rompf and Creditweb)
items.sourcesNote: Figures per baufi24.de and the €uro/SWI press release, as of October 2026

items.name: Hüttig & Rompf
items.beratungText: Free and non-binding — Hüttig & Rompf earns a commission from the lending bank if a financing deal closes
items.besonderheitenText: €1.5 billion in mortgage volume arranged in 2024 (around 4,500 loan contracts per the provider); named "top mortgage broker" by €uro
items.sourcesNote: Figures per huettig-rompf.de (the provider's own claims, not independently verified), as of October 2026

items.name: CHECK24 Mortgage Comparison
items.partnerbankenText: Comparison of offers from over 500 providers per the provider's page; a specific list of partner banks is not disclosed
items.standorteText: Part of CHECK24 Vergleichsportal GmbH (Munich); no separate location count given for the mortgage division
items.beratungText: Free and non-binding — CHECK24 states it is funded by commissions received when a deal closes
items.besonderheitenText: Press reports (versicherungsbote.de) and the current provider page suggest CHECK24 has discontinued its own in-house mortgage brokerage and now runs the comparison through its partner Interhyp ("mortgage comparison from our partner Interhyp") — whether CHECK24 still operates independently or only as a lead referrer isn't clearly stated on the page
items.sourcesNote: Figures per check24.de (the provider's own claims, not independently verified), as of October 2026

items.name: PlanetHome
items.partnerbankenText: Number of partner banks not stated on the provider's website
items.standorteText: Nationwide advisor network; exact location/advisor count not consistently stated
items.beratungText: Free and non-binding — PlanetHome earns a commission from the lending bank if a financing deal closes
items.besonderheitenText: Offers property brokerage alongside mortgage financing from a single provider; part of the PlanetHome Group
items.sourcesNote: Figures per planethome.de (the provider's own claims, not independently verified), as of October 2026

items.name: Hypofriend
items.partnerbankenText: Over 750 banks and financing partners per the provider
items.beratungText: Free and non-binding — Hypofriend earns a commission from the lending bank if a financing deal closes
items.besonderheitenText: Positions itself as a digital/online-first broker using algorithmic bank matching rather than traditional branch-based advice
items.sourcesNote: Figures per hypofriend.de (the provider's own claims, not independently verified), as of October 2026

items.name: FINANZCHECK Mortgages
items.partnerbankenText: Comparison platform, part of the Verivox group; exact partner-bank count not stated on the provider's website
items.standorteText: Online comparison with phone/in-person advice; no separate location count given
items.beratungText: Free and non-binding — FINANZCHECK earns a commission from the lending bank if a financing deal closes
items.besonderheitenText: Best known for its loan comparison; mortgages are offered as an additional comparison product
items.sourcesNote: Figures per finanzcheck.de (the provider's own claims, not independently verified), as of October 2026

items.name: Vergleich.de Mortgages
items.partnerbankenText: Number of partner banks not stated on the provider's website
items.standorteText: Pure online comparison portal with no branch network of its own
items.beratungText: Free and non-binding — Vergleich.de earns a commission from the lending bank or partner broker
items.besonderheitenText: Comparison portal covering several financial products (loans, insurance, mortgages); holds no broker license of its own and refers users to partner brokers
items.sourcesNote: Figures per vergleich.de (the provider's own claims, not independently verified), as of October 2026

items.name: ImmobilienScout24 Mortgages
items.partnerbankenText: Number of partner banks not stated on the provider's website
items.standorteText: Online comparison portal, part of ImmobilienScout24 (property listings portal)
items.beratungText: Free and non-binding — ImmobilienScout24 earns a commission from the lending bank or partner broker
items.besonderheitenText: Mortgage comparison integrated directly into the property search, so financing and property search are available from a single source; press reports indicate it works with partners such as Interhyp
items.sourcesNote: Figures per immobilienscout24.de, as of October 2026
